dialogues.jp: 「今日で、学校は最後だな」
dialogues.en: "Today's the final day of school..."
dialogues.text: "Today's the final day of school..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「最後じゃありません。何言ってるんですか」
dialogues.en: "Whatever are you talking about? It's not the final day."
dialogues.text: "Whatever are you talking about? It's not the final day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その｛ぶべつ／侮蔑｝した目はやめろ」
dialogues.en: "Don't look at me with those eyes..."
dialogues.text: "Don't look at me with those eyes..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「卒業式は、１５日です。後１週間もあるじゃ
　ないですか」
dialogues.en:
"The graduation party is on the 15th. There's still one week
to go."
dialogues.text:
"The graduation party is on the 15th. There's still one week
to go."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、３年の修了過程は今日で終わりだぞ。
　お前、自分が風紀委員でやることがいっぱい
　あるから、ひがんでるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"But for the third years, this IS the last day of school.
Aren't you sore that the disciplinary committee makes you
come back?"
dialogues.text:
"But for the third years, this IS the last day of school.
Aren't you sore that the disciplinary committee makes you
come back?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そのくらいで、ひがんだりしません！　ひが
　むもんですか！」
dialogues.en: "Sore!? Not in the slightest!"
dialogues.text: "Sore!? Not in the slightest!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、いつもより強い力で俺の脇腹を小突く。
dialogues.en: Nemu poked me from the side with force.
dialogues.text: Nemu poked me from the side with force.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私には、無事卒業式を終わらせるために、兄
　さんや杉並君のような悪の枢軸を壊滅させる
　という大切な仕事があるんです」
dialogues.en:
"My job, to prevent the the roots of evil, like you and
Suginami-kun from ruining the graduation party, is extremely
important!"
dialogues.text:
"My job, to prevent the the roots of evil, like you and
Suginami-kun from ruining the graduation party, is extremely
important!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「誰が悪の枢軸だ。俺は何も企んではいない。
　──杉並の方は知らんがな」
dialogues.en:
"The hell? I've got nothing in mind for the graduation
party. ...I can't say the same for Suginami though."
dialogues.text:
"The hell? I've got nothing in mind for the graduation
party. ...I can't say the same for Suginami though."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「本当ですか？　兄さんには過去幾度と犯罪経
　歴がありますからね」
dialogues.en:
"How true would that be... your past deeds don't tally with
that statement."
dialogues.text:
"How true would that be... your past deeds don't tally with
that statement."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「俺は、もう足を洗ったんだ。もう子どもじゃ
　ない」
dialogues.en: "I've washed my hands off that. I'm not a kid anymore."
dialogues.text: "I've washed my hands off that. I'm not a kid anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、兄さんは、ブラックリストの中のブラッ
　クリスト、ブラックブラックリストにしっか
　り名前が載ってますからね」
dialogues.en:
"Your name's still etched in the blacklist within the
discplinary committee's blacklist, though."
dialogues.text:
"Your name's still etched in the blacklist within the
discplinary committee's blacklist, though."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えらく愉快な名前のリストだな」
dialogues.en:
"The names on that list should bring smiles to anyone's
faces."
dialogues.text:
"The names on that list should bring smiles to anyone's
faces."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく！　私だってちゃんとした卒業式を
　迎えたいんですからね！」
dialogues.en:
"In any case! I won't let you do as you wish with the
graduation party!"
dialogues.text:
"In any case! I won't let you do as you wish with the
graduation party!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「俺だってそうだ！　卒業式くらい厳かな気持
　ちで迎えたいわい！」
dialogues.en:
"Like I'd want to mess with such a sombre and boring thing
anyway!"
dialogues.text:
"Like I'd want to mess with such a sombre and boring thing
anyway!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうだか……」
dialogues.en: "I wonder..."
dialogues.text: "I wonder..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「──まあまあ、先輩方。朝からケンカするの
　はやめましょうよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Now now, senpais! You shouldn't be arguing so early in
the morning!"
dialogues.text:
"...Now now, senpais! You shouldn't be arguing so early in
the morning!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「み、美春、いつからそこに」
dialogues.en: "M, Miharu? When did you pop in?"
dialogues.text: "M, Miharu? When did you pop in?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩が悪の枢軸と呼ばれた頃からですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Right about when Nemu-senpai called you the root of all
evil."
dialogues.text:
"Right about when Nemu-senpai called you the root of all
evil."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……なんかイヤな言い方だな」
dialogues.en: "...What nice timing."
dialogues.text: "...What nice timing."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「音夢先輩も、たまには朝倉先輩のことを信じ
　てあげましょうよ」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-senpai, you should believe in Asakura-senpai as well!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu-senpai, you should believe in Asakura-senpai as well!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うーん……、確かにここ最近は目立った行動
　はしてないし……」
dialogues.en:
"Well... it is true that he hasn't been particularly
conspicious around the disciplinary committee lately..."
dialogues.text:
"Well... it is true that he hasn't been particularly
conspicious around the disciplinary committee lately..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だろ？」
dialogues.en: "Of course?"
dialogues.text: "Of course?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ね、月城さんもそう思うよね」
dialogues.en: "See, Tsukishiro thinks so too!"
dialogues.text: "See, Tsukishiro thinks so too!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "--T, Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "--T, Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.jp:
よく見ると、美春と音夢の間にちびっこい月城
がとことこと歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
Looking more closely, I found the tiny Tsukishiro calmly
walking in between Nemu and Miharu.
dialogues.text:
Looking more closely, I found the tiny Tsukishiro calmly
walking in between Nemu and Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、ホントに！」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah, she's here!"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah, she's here!"

dialogues.jp:
隣にいた音夢も気づかないというのは、どうい
う訳か。
dialogues.en:
She just noticed it despite walking at her side the whole
time...
dialogues.text:
She just noticed it despite walking at her side the whole
time...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「並木道の入り口で会ったから、一緒に行こうっ
　て誘ったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I met her at the entrance to the Sakura Avenue, and asked
whether we could walk together to school!"
dialogues.text:
"I met her at the entrance to the Sakura Avenue, and asked
whether we could walk together to school!"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、こくんと頷いた。相変わらず、胸の中
には人形を大切に抱いていた。
dialogues.en:
A quick nod. As usual, she held that doll tightly to her
chest.
dialogues.text:
A quick nod. As usual, she held that doll tightly to her
chest.

dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、俺は卒業式には何もしない。風紀
　委員のそのブラックブラックブラックリスト
　からは外しとけ」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'm not gonna do anything to the graduation party.
You can remove me from that black-black-blacklist."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'm not gonna do anything to the graduation party.
You can remove me from that black-black-blacklist."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ブラックがひとつ多いですよ。自分から更な
　る暗黒の海へ飛び込まないでください」
dialogues.en:
"You added one extra black. Don't throw yourself into more
infamy than you already are."
dialogues.text:
"You added one extra black. Don't throw yourself into more
infamy than you already are."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、朝倉先輩の意思をきちんと委員会に
　提出しておきますから」
dialogues.en: "I'd put a good word in for you at the next meeting!"
dialogues.text: "I'd put a good word in for you at the next meeting!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、もともと杉並君１点に絞って警戒しよ
　うって話もあるんですけどね」
dialogues.en:
"There's still one more name to be far more fearful of,
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"There's still one more name to be far more fearful of,
anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、あいつは危険人物だからな。俺はあく
　まで年間行事のエンタテイメント性をあげよ
　うと思ってただけだからな」
dialogues.en:
"Suginami's plainly dangerous. I was just thinking of adding
some entertainment to the yearly functions, before."
dialogues.text:
"Suginami's plainly dangerous. I was just thinking of adding
some entertainment to the yearly functions, before."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……わざわざあげる必要はありません」
dialogues.en: "...I do not believe that is needed."
dialogues.text: "...I do not believe that is needed."

dialogues.jp:
ま、そうだけど、どうせ何かをやるなら、より
楽しい方がいいってだけだ。
dialogues.en:
That may be true, but getting yourself involved, even in a
bad way, makes it more fun somehow.
dialogues.text:
That may be true, but getting yourself involved, even in a
bad way, makes it more fun somehow.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、さっきも言ったとおり、卒業式まで
何かをしようとは思わない。
dialogues.en:
However, as I said earlier, I don't plan on getting involved
in this graduation ceremony.
dialogues.text:
However, as I said earlier, I don't plan on getting involved
in this graduation ceremony.

dialogues.jp: それになんだか、そういうのも飽きてしまった。
dialogues.en:
It's getting more bothersome and tiresome to think of new
things to do.
dialogues.text:
It's getting more bothersome and tiresome to think of new
things to do.

dialogues.jp:
わしは全権を杉並に委ねて、隠居することにし
よう……。わしの時代は終わったんじゃ……。
dialogues.en:
I shall pass my entire legacy for Suginami to follow. My
time is almost up...
dialogues.text:
I shall pass my entire legacy for Suginami to follow. My
time is almost up...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、なんだか、年老いた顔をしてますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Senpai, why is your face suddenly looking so old and
weary?"
dialogues.text:
"Senpai, why is your face suddenly looking so old and
weary?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか？」
dialogues.en: "I, is it?"
dialogues.text: "I, is it?"

dialogues.jp:
ま、隠居なんて冗談じゃあないけどな。まだま
だ俺の時代だ。
dialogues.en: That was just a joke, anyway. I've got lots more to work on.
dialogues.text: That was just a joke, anyway. I've got lots more to work on.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……天枷さん」
dialogues.en: "...Amakase-san."
dialogues.text: "...Amakase-san."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Haeeh? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Haeeh? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...The time."
dialogues.text: "...The time."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、もうそんな時間？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah, it's that late already!?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah, it's that late already!?"

dialogues.jp: 美春が腕時計を見て、目を丸くする。
dialogues.en:
Miharu's eyes grew round as she glanced at the watch on her
wrist.
dialogues.text:
Miharu's eyes grew round as she glanced at the watch on her
wrist.

dialogues.speaker: 美春
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩、音夢先輩、急いだ方がいいですよ。
　あんまりのんびりしてると、大変なことにな
　ります！」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-senpai, Nemu-senpai, hurry! If we don't, we're
going to be late!"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-senpai, Nemu-senpai, hurry! If we don't, we're
going to be late!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お先に！」
dialogues.en: "We're going ahead!"
dialogues.text: "We're going ahead!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, farewell."

dialogues.jp:
美春と月城は、そう言って猛ダッシュで学校へ
向かって走っていった。
dialogues.en:
Miharu and Tsukishiro went on a mad dash immediately after,
towards school.
dialogues.text:
Miharu and Tsukishiro went on a mad dash immediately after,
towards school.

dialogues.jp:
時計を見ると、俺がいつも走って学校へ向かう
時間とほぼ同じだった。
dialogues.en:
I took at a look at my own watch. It's about the time where
I'd be running to school, if I was late...
dialogues.text:
I took at a look at my own watch. It's about the time where
I'd be running to school, if I was late...

dialogues.jp:
周りをよく見れば、いつのまにか人も多く、早
足で学校に向かう連中も何人かいた。
dialogues.en:
Looking around my, I saw the usual suspects trying to beat
the first bell.
dialogues.text:
Looking around my, I saw the usual suspects trying to beat
the first bell.

dialogues.jp: どうやら、無駄話が過ぎたらしい。
dialogues.en: Looks like we talked too much...
dialogues.text: Looks like we talked too much...

dialogues.jp: 「音夢、俺達も急ぐぞ」
dialogues.en: "Nemu, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Nemu, let's go."

dialogues.jp: と、ダッシュをかける。
dialogues.en: I broke into a run.
dialogues.text: I broke into a run.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん、待ってよー！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, nii-san, wait up!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, nii-san, wait up!"

dialogues.jp:
さすがに音夢も、卒業間際に汚点を残したくは
ないらしい。
dialogues.en:
No way would Nemu want a blot on her record, this close to
graduation.
dialogues.text:
No way would Nemu want a blot on her record, this close to
graduation.

dialogues.jp: もちろん、俺もだが。
dialogues.en: Of course, neither did I.
dialogues.text: Of course, neither did I.

dialogues.jp: ◆最後の学校？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Final School Day?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Final School Day?◆

dialogues.jp:
いよいよ、修了課程の最終日を迎えて、俺は音
夢と登校していた。すると美春が俺たちを目ざ
とく発見して、寄ってくる。
dialogues.en:
The final days of the course was near. Miharu spotted Nemu
and I walking to school, and tagged along.
dialogues.text:
The final days of the course was near. Miharu spotted Nemu
and I walking to school, and tagged along.

dialogues.jp:
馬鹿話をしていると、いつの間にやら月城まで
混ざっていた。侮れないやつだ。
dialogues.en:
Talking a whole lot of nothing, Tsukishiro somehow sneaked
in between us while we weren't looking.
dialogues.text:
Talking a whole lot of nothing, Tsukishiro somehow sneaked
in between us while we weren't looking.

dialogues.jp:
音夢、美春と戯れていると、最終日だというの
に危うく遅刻しそうになる。俺たちは慌てて走
り始めた。
dialogues.en:
With all the time I spent having fun with Nemu and Miharu,
we almost became late for school, and had to rush.
dialogues.text:
With all the time I spent having fun with Nemu and Miharu,
we almost became late for school, and had to rush.
